regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, keywords, and SI availability sentence
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate method claim. The paper says SI is available online, but source_mapping.json leaves SI association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.
The FeCl3/TMSCl conversion to products 1 or 2 is explicitly previous 2012 work and is classified as a literature example, not a current-paper experiment.
The 3+4 to Int-1/Int-2/Int-3 to 5/6 drawing is a generic mechanistic proposal; intermediates are not isolated experiments and question marks are preserved as uncertainty.

unresolved: Generic Scheme 1 R groups and compact intermediates do not define unique structures, time, scale, or yields.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Results and Discussion initial 3a/4a experiment
regions.finding: The 52 h/43% observation is Table 1 entry 1, not a duplicate. Alternative 6a is explicitly not observed; Figure 1 is characterization of 5a.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–14, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Fourteen distinct optimization runs were retained with row catalyst/loading, TMSCl presence/loading, time, NMR yield or dash/no-product outcome, aldehyde recovery, footnote 3a-equivalent overrides, and internal-standard bases. Entry 9 is linked to the page-4 detailed 5a experiment.

regions.region: page 2 right-column optimization and scope prose
regions.finding: The prose identifies entry 9 as optimal and narratively introduces Table 2 and Scheme 2. These statements are linked to the row/arrow records on page 3 rather than duplicated.
ORTEP of 5a supports the product assignment but is characterization, not a separate synthesis or machine-structure verification.

unresolved: Most Table 1 rows omit scale, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated mass.
Figure 1 does not certify any machine SMILES.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–14, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Fourteen independent aldehyde-scope rows were retained with 3a/aldehyde equivalents, FeCl3 loading including the entry-4 30 mol% override, TMSCl, CH2Cl2, room temperature, 24 h, and isolated yields. Rows 1–9 are linked to detailed pages 4–6.
Two distinct alkynal reactions were retained: 4p to 5p (82%) and 4q to 5q (51%) under the displayed FeCl3/TMSCl conditions.
Retained ordinary E-5r formation, a separate 1.4 g-scale/1.398 g/79% repeat, and distinct 3b/3c reactions to E-5s/E-5t. The gram-scale repeat is not merged with the 82% ordinary run.

The 5o epoxidation arrow was retained and cross-checked against page-10 text. The scheme's 0 °C/10.7 h summary conflicts with the detailed ice-bath-addition/warm-to-room-temperature/10.7 h operation; both are recorded.

regions.region: page 3 conclusions and Experimental Section general information
regions.finding: Conclusions add no experiment. General information establishes oven-dried Schlenk tubes and oil-bath temperature convention for the detailed experimental section but is not itself a reaction record.

unresolved: Scheme 2/3 yield bases and most absolute quantities/workups are not printed on page 3.
Scheme 4 and detailed-text temperature programs conflict; page 10 is context only, not covered here.
